$comment: What equipment exists where. Joined with each exercise's 'requires' to derive where it can be performed - see validate.py. Never store 'can be done at home' on an exercise; it is derived from these two facts, so buying equipment reclassifies everything by editing one line here.

gym.label: Gym
notes: Surveyed 2026-09-19. All equipment tags confirmed present.
Stack increments: 5 kg on the machines checked (leg curl, standing glute, seated calf). Cable columns and older machines not yet spot-checked.
Dumbbells start at 3 kg. Step size at the light end not yet recorded.

THREE cable setups: multi-station (pulley top or bottom), crossover (two side pulleys), and an adjustable column with the pulley on a vertical sled - any height. The adjustable column is the most useful single piece of equipment here given the constraints.
THREE leg presses with incomparable load scales - see equipment-survey.md. The 90-100 kg figure belongs to the horizontal seat-moving unit only.
The pec deck does NOT reverse. Rear delts are done on a cable.
Smith machine present but excluded: fixed bar path, rigid bilateral, barbell.

home.label: Home
notes: Dumbbells: one modular handle, loadable ONLY to 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 kg, currently set at 7 kg. Plus a fixed pair of 3 kg.
The 3 kg pair is below the useful training range for lateral raises - pattern maintenance only.
No bench, no cable, no bar. Used as a fallback on a missed gym day, not as a regime.
